input.summary: Plunge A, keep feeding the top until A-B-C-D gives 5x and base bonus reaches 19,000, then use a full-depth vari-target collect at maximum bonus, rebuild, and repeat a lit spinner when its return is safe.

quickInfo.name: A-B-C-D lanes
quickInfo.summary: The four top letters advance Bonus X: the first letter earns 2x, then later letters advance through 3x, 4x, and 5x.

quickInfo.name: Star-rollover letter
quickInfo.summary: The right-side star rollovers award the lit A-B-C-D letter, while spinner hits move which letter is lit.

quickInfo.name: Base bonus
quickInfo.summary: Base bonus builds to 19,000, and the safest early goal is to combine that maximum with 5x.

quickInfo.name: Vari-target collect
quickInfo.summary: Each vari-target collects 1,000, 2,000, or 3,000 of base bonus according to depth and applies the current multiplier.

quickInfo.name: Lit spinner
quickInfo.summary: A full-depth shot to either vari-target lights the spinner for 1,000 per spin.

steps.text: Plunge the A lane when its position is reachable.
From the right flipper, shoot the right orbit back to the top.
Use the top lanes and the lit right-side star rollover to collect missing A-B-C-D letters.
Continue upper-playfield feeds until Bonus X reaches 5x and base bonus reaches 19,000.
At 19,000, shoot the safer vari-target deeply enough to collect 3,000 and light the spinner.
Rebuild the reduced base bonus through upper play.
Repeat the lit spinner only after one observed return shows that its feed is controlled.

fallback.title: Safe-side upper feeds
fallback.when: Use this plan when the right-side star-rollover route or vari-target rebounds are unreliable.

steps.text: Use the upper-left feed or the right orbit, whichever returns safely on this copy.
Let top-lane action collect A-B-C-D and build base bonus.
Avoid direct vari-target shots until 5x and 19,000 are ready.
Continue upper feeds instead of forcing a dangerous collect.

alternatives.title: Bonus-value award timing
alternatives.when: Use this plan only when Extra Ball or Special is enabled and the exact bonus-value award has tournament value.

steps.text: Read the base bonus before a vari-target collect.
At 19,000, collect 3,000 to return to 16,000 or collect another amount that reaches the needed award value.
Shoot the lit upper-left target, upper-right target, or Special lane only when its award is enabled.
Otherwise, resume the upper-playfield route.
Complete A-B-C-D for 5x.
Keep feeding the top lanes until base bonus reaches 19,000.
Use a deep vari-target shot to collect multiplied bonus and light the spinner.
Rebuild the spent base bonus through the top.
Repeat the collect while its same-side return remains safe.

playfieldReferences.label: Right-side star rollovers
playfieldReferences.description: The right-side rollovers that award whichever A-B-C-D letter is lit.

playfieldReferences.label: Bonus-collect vari-target
playfieldReferences.description: Either variable-depth target beside the center opening; deeper hits collect more base bonus.

playfieldReferences.label: Lit spinner
playfieldReferences.description: The spinner lit for 1,000 per spin by a full-depth vari-target hit.

techniques.name: Right-side top feed
techniques.instruction: From the right flipper, send the ball along the right side toward the star rollovers and top lanes. Favor a clean lane entry over a hard post hit.

techniques.name: Vari-target depth control
techniques.instruction: Shoot the center of the safer vari-target. Use enough force for the intended 1,000, 2,000, or 3,000 collect without striking its side post.

techniques.name: Spinner-return test
techniques.instruction: Watch one complete spinner return. Repeat only if the ball reaches a flipper without a center-drain or slingshot deflection.

cautions.issue: Balls leaving the bumpers or spinner can fall through the center or enter a slingshot.
cautions.response: Prepare both flippers before the ball exits the upper area. Stop repeating a spinner that returns out of control.

cautions.issue: A vari-target can rebound toward the center on an individual machine.
cautions.response: Test each vari-target once at moderate force. Use only the side that falls toward its same-side flipper.

cautions.issue: The posts beside the vari-targets create severe misses.
cautions.response: Do not force the vari-target from a poor angle. Return to the upper-playfield route when the center is not open.

checkBeforePlay: Confirm the 1978 solid-state Dragon; the electro-mechanical edition has different scoring and must use its installed instruction card.
Confirm ball count, replay, Extra Ball and Special handling, tilt, bonus carry, and whether vari-target depths register reliably.
Test upper feeds, star rollovers, spinner strength, both vari-target returns, and the center posts beside them before choosing a collect route.
